title: Big joe bean bag chair
text: Big joe bean bag chair. I was REALLY nervous about buying one of these for my 8 year old grandson - but it was the first thing on his christmas list.  First, this chair lists as a 'dorm room chair'- indicating 'adult' size, but I have to say - it is truly child size.  I purchased the black.  The material is quite hardy in my opinion.  And I will say that it has withstood some pretty vigorous use - my grandsons are 8 and 11 - so it's used.  So far, I have nothing bad to report - no splitting or tearing or exploding of tiny beads.  I dropped one star because it is in NO WAY an adult size chair.  8 year grandson is thrilled and to me, that's all that matters.  Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

Built in handle makes it easy to Grab and Go with your Big Joe, whether you are watching TV in the living room, studying in your room, or playing games in the basement | Built in pockets are a convenient way to stash your smartphones, remotes, and books.
Designed and Filled in the USA in a Zero Landfill Facility
description: Take a load off in the Big Joe Dorm bean bag chair in SmartMax fabric. Easy to clean fabric makes this chair a great fit in kids rooms, dorm rooms, basements, bedrooms - or any room! Its built in handle makes it easy to grab and go from room to room, whether you're hanging with friends, watching TV, reading, or just cruising the internet. It's the nature of every bean bag to go flat over time, but if you feel your bag has gone flat unreasonably soon, give our Customer Service team a call and they can help you out! As with all Big Joe bean bag chairs, its sealed with 2, safety locking zippers for child safety - but don't worry! If you need to add more filling, just take a look at the tag sewn into every bag, it shows how a paper clip or safety pin can unzip the bag to refill it with fresh beans. And while we're talking beans, did you know that our beans are 100% recyclable, and are made from 80% recycled materials? Big Joe loves being green almost as much as we love making you feel comfortable. But we don't stop with you or Mother Earth. 10% of all profits are donated back into the community. When Big Joe says "Comfort For All!" - we mean it!
